correctness.rationale: Explicit inversion leaves x_0 as the sole choice from tau^{-1}(y_{-1}); fixed points correspond bijectively to future symbols. Thus c_d=d n_d, and a conjugacy preserves degree on its bijection of fixed-point sets. Conversely matching fibres of equal cardinality yields alphabet permutations alpha,beta with tau_prime alpha=beta tau and an explicit coordinate conjugacy. Every partition yields a surjection, and all periodic/entropy equalities follow by exact periodic completion and two continuous shift factors. Direct finite checker passed 5315 surjections for future alphabet size 2 through 6; the proof does not rely on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: A natural complete classification of finite-alphabet full noninvertible zip-shift models, relevant to recognizing whether two symbolic encodings give the same dynamical system; it allows every nonuniform fibre partition and treats arbitrary topological conjugacies, not only relabelings. It yields the exact p(N) count and all realizable fixed-point branching polynomials. Same entropy and entire ordinary periodic spectrum fail to distinguish N=4 five nonconjugate types, giving a substantive motivation beyond a parameter substitution.
